instruction_wrapper_measured_comparison.method: same 2 queries embedded twice: once raw, once wrapped as 'Instruct: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query\nQuery:<query>' (official HF template); documents never wrapped in either case, per card guidance
instruction_wrapper_measured_comparison.measured_effect: wrapping did NOT flip the top-ranked doc in this tiny corpus, but it materially changed absolute cosine values and margins in both directions (one query's top score rose, the other's fell) — confirms the template has a real, non-trivial effect on this deployment and must be a fixed, recorded profile field, not an implementation detail left to chance

model_revision_identity.note: the OpenAI-compatible /v1/models `id` ("text-embedding-qwen3-embedding-0.6b") is a MUTABLE LM Studio display label, not an immutable revision — it does not encode quantization or file hash. The GGUF file's sha256 above is the only immutable revision proof available locally.
model_revision_identity.portable_profile_recommendation: a consumer that needs to detect a model swap should pin {provider: "lmstudio", model_id: <api id>, file_sha256: <gguf hash>, dimension: 1024} and treat a hash change as a new embedding space per D-001's model-space-isolation invariant — the API alone cannot distinguish a requantized/updated file with the same displayed id

instruction_template_and_limits.query_template: Instruct: {task_description}\nQuery:{query}  (documents get NO instruction wrapper — passed as raw text)
instruction_template_and_limits.example_task_description: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
instruction_template_and_limits.measured_perf_impact_of_omitting_instruc: model card states ~1-5% retrieval drop in most scenarios if the query-side instruction is omitted; not independently re-measured in this probe
instruction_template_and_limits.context_length: 32K tokens (model card); HF usage example itself truncates to max_length=8192 with truncation=True
instruction_template_and_limits.truncation_behavior: tokenizer-side truncation is SILENT (no error) per the model card's own example code
instruction_template_and_limits.lm_studio_side_truncation_visibility: NOT verified — this probe's /v1/embeddings calls returned usage.prompt_tokens=0 for every request, so LM Studio's response gives no token-count signal a caller could use to detect silent truncation

propose_profile_fields.input_bound_handling: REQUIRED before P-03 implementation: caller-side token counting/truncation with an explicit limit below 32K (LM Studio does not report truncation), so silent truncation is never delegated to the server

sqlite_vec_pre_filter_probe.setup: real SQLCipher DB via airag.db.connect.init_db (fixed 32-byte synthetic key, RETAINED not deleted — see reproduction.vec_probe_script above), sqlite_vec.load()'d on the same connection, single vec0 table with dim=8 literal synthetic vectors, distance_metric=cosine declared explicitly on the vector column
sqlite_vec_pre_filter_probe.table: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE probe_vec0 USING vec0(embedding_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, embedding FLOAT[8] distance_metric=cosine, collection TEXT, active INTEGER)
sqlite_vec_pre_filter_probe.rows: colA: 3 active rows near query direction + 1 INACTIVE distractor placed EXACTLY at the query vector (cosine distance 0, guaranteed #1 globally); colB: 3 active rows near an orthogonal direction + 1 inactive cross-collection distractor placed near colA's direction — exact literal vectors are in p03a-vec-probe.out.json / p03a-vec-probe.py
sqlite_vec_pre_filter_probe.filtered_query: ... WHERE embedding MATCH ? AND k = 4 AND collection = 'colA' AND active = 1 ORDER BY distance
sqlite_vec_pre_filter_probe.supported_knn_filter_form: plain declared columns (not `+auxiliary`, not necessarily `partition key`) used directly in the `MATCH ... AND k = N AND <col> = <val> ...` WHERE clause are pushed down and filtered BEFORE the k-limit is applied — verified empirically here, not just asserted from docs

limitations: single tiny synthetic corpus — not a retrieval benchmark, ranking correctness shown for 2 queries x 5 docs only

usage.prompt_tokens is always 0 from this LM Studio build's /v1/embeddings — token-level truncation cannot be detected from the API response alone; must be enforced client-side before P-03 implementation
instruction-template omission's claimed 1-5% retrieval drop is quoted from the model card, not independently re-measured here

sqlite-vec community docs list supported metadata operators as =, !=, >, >=, <, <=, BETWEEN and do not clearly state IN; this probe measured IN working in 0.1.9 — treat as this-version-observed, not a documented guarantee

vec probe used dim=8 synthetic vectors for speed/clarity of the filter-correctness test, not the real measured 1024-dim Qwen output — filter pre-limiting behavior is dimension-independent so this does not affect that finding, but dimension-specific performance at 1024 was not measured here
GGUF file mtime (2025-12-02) is a local download timestamp, not a model release date — not used as evidence of anything other than local cache state
model revision proof (sha256) is only as good as this local cache; a consumer on a different machine needs its own hash, not a value copied from this file
